CustomField.label: Customer Code
CustomField.description:
★R12 The customer company code as it arrived in the CSV, and half of the key the import matches a Contact on. This reinstates what R7 designed and R8 struck out — "cust_cd arrives in the CSV and lands on Event_Attendee__c" — because the reason R8 struck it out has gone.
R8 derived the code instead: Contact__c → Account → AccountNumber. That was the only route available while the import was forbidden to read Contact, and it is circular now that the import matches on the code. A key cannot be the thing you find the Contact with AND the thing you read off the Contact once found. The CSV is the source; the Account is the confirmation.
WHAT IT IS NOT: a relationship. Nothing dereferences it. A row carrying a code this org has never heard of is stored as-is and simply matches no Contact — the import does not validate it, because a code the org does not recognise is a data question for whoever produced the file, not an error the import can resolve.
Blank is ordinary and means "not a customer": professors, press and other guests who belong to no Account. Those rows attempt no Contact match at all. See design.md Open Question 21 for what approves them.
